description: Current open-weight models for one task, latest version of each family, in the same order as the site. Give memory_gb (and device) to keep only models whose smallest listed weight option fits; memory is estimated only for text LLMs and taken from vendor sources otherwise, and is "unknown" when neither exists. No ratings and no speed estimates.

device.description: apple counts MLX weights; gpu and cpu do not.

memory_gb.description: GPU VRAM or unified memory in GB.

name: find_models
title: Find local models for a task
